name: Mermaid

load.note: Any light setting works — stay on whatever is already on if it feels supportive.

summary: Seated side-on with a hand on the footbar, push the carriage away into a long side stretch.

layers.title: Add a twist
layers.text: At the far point, turn the chest to the floor and thread the top arm under.

layers.title: Away from the bar
layers.text: Finish with a side bend the other way.

modifications: Sit cross-legged or on the box for sore knees or hips.

cautions.note: Folded-leg sitting; sit cross-legged or on a box.

cues:
Both sit bones stay down.
Reach up before you go over.
Top shoulder away from the ear.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
